title: Karpaty
summary: Karpaty refers to various subjects, primarily associated with the Carpathian Mountains and several locations in Ukraine, as well as sports teams and other geographic references.

sections.heading: Geographical Significance
paragraphs: The term Karpaty is closely associated with the [[carpathians|Carpathian Mountains]], a significant mountain range in Central and [[eastern-europe|Eastern Europe]] that stretches across several countries, including [[ukraine|Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Sports Teams
paragraphs: Karpaty is also a name linked to various sports teams, including FC Karpaty, which has multiple references, and SKA Karpaty [[lviv|Lviv]], a notable football club based in Lviv, Ukraine.

sections.heading: Settled Places in Ukraine
paragraphs: [[coal-in-ukraine|In Ukraine]], there are settled places named Karpaty located in [[zakarpattia-oblast|Zakarpattia Oblast]] and [[luhansk-oblast|Luhansk Oblast]], which contribute to the cultural and geographic diversity of the country.

sections.heading: International References
paragraphs: The name Karpaty is not limited to Ukraine; it also appears in other countries, such as Karpaty in Ulyanovsk Oblast, Russia, and Karpaty in Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland.
